extDesc.message: Save your ChatGPT and Gemini conversations to your own Mem0 account, with your own user ID.

tipManual.message: Click to save the last exchange

apiKeyLabel.message: Mem0 API key (stored only in this browser)

userIdLabel.message: User ID (required) — memories are saved under this user_id

modeManual.message: Manual — only when I click “Save to Mem0”

redactLabel.message: Hide obvious secrets (API keys, tokens, card numbers) before sending

privacy.message: What is sent: only the question and answer you save, plus site, conversation ID and URL, directly to Mem0. Nothing goes anywhere else.

needUser.message: Set your User ID in Settings.

secAccountDesc.message: How the extension talks to your Mem0 account.

secUserDesc.message: Every memory is saved under this user. Use the same ID you use in other Mem0 integrations to keep everything together.

secCaptureDesc.message: Choose when conversations are saved and on which sites. The app_id identifies the source in Mem0.

diagNoTab.message: The extension is not active in this tab. Open chatgpt.com or gemini.google.com in Edge and reload the page.

secFilterDesc.message: Instructions sent with every conversation telling Mem0 what is worth remembering. Leave empty to let Mem0 decide on its own.

defaultInstructions.message: Extract only durable facts about the user: preferences, opinions, personal and professional details, projects, decisions, goals and life context. Ignore calculations, greetings, one-off questions, general trivia, generic content from the assistant's answers and any fact that is not about the user. When the user changes a preference or decision, record the new one making clear it replaces the previous one.
